Good point. I think doing this two makes sense:

- Disable the button if it's not on supported browser.
- Expose `hideOnUnsupportedBrowsers` with a default value `false`.

What should happen if our user didn't put `hideOnUnsupportedBrowsers={true}` and end-user tries on unsupported browser? For now, they will see a disabled button. Should we put a tooltip telling why it's disabled?
